label: owns
definition: Argument 1 owns or previously owned company, organization or asset 2.
scope_notes: Parent, owner, acquisition and explicit partial ownership qualify in parent-to-child direction. Being born in a place, employment, management alone, or a proposed/rejected acquisition does not.

facts.reason: Bobbitt was born in Ecuador and had childhood there; Ecuador is not an owned asset in these rows.
DoubleClick is an Internet company/group. These sector compounds do not say it owns the Internet; company-poss is at best the reverse association.
General Electric explicitly owns NBC and is identified as its owner and parent.
Sheng was born and studied in Shanghai; the rows contain no ownership.
The sole row says Leach was born in England, not that she owns it.
